title: Riot Officer Beating Caught
body: Israel's police oversight authority is reviewing footage of a Yasam riot police officer striking yeshiva bochurim with a baton in Yerushalayim. The probe is being handled by the Justice Ministry's internal investigations department.

title: Malky Mitnick Petirah
body: Rav Mordechai Mitnick's wife, Mrs. Malky Mitnick, passed away. She was the daughter of Rav Elya Kanarek, rosh yeshiva of Yeshiva Ohr Hameir of Peekskill.
